are server-side data: use these when the Journal / achievement rewards are rebuilt; check each against the
client's achievement data (gameData Achievement* tables / re achievements.tsv).

## Getting started goals

| Goal | Requirements | Reward |
|---|---|---|
| Becoming a Luminary | Use your Travel menu to return to your own Build Site · Travel to "other worlds" and visit a landscape that doesn't have "Pioneer" in the name. These have more varied geography than Pioneer landscapes. · Use your Travel menu to travel to an Underground Adventure. These adventure areas contain rarer mining resources as well as outposts to explore! · Open the help guide [F12] to refer to any of this information again in the future! · Defeat creatures in the caverns! Remember to use your grappling hook to climb safely. (?/5) · Activate a Lightstone from your inventory to help you see | 30 Lumens · 5 Luminary Score points · Title: Luminary |
| Building Block Basics | Copy [CTRL+C] some blocks you have selected with the Selection Tool [3] · Open the Blocks tab of the Build Mode · Use the Add Tool [1] · Place blocks (?/200) · Use the Delete Tool [2] · Delete blocks (?/200) · Use the Paint Tool [4] on the selection volume to pain the entire selection · Use the Selection Tool [3] to select some blocks on your site · Paste [CTRL+V] the blocks you copied | 30 Lumens · 5 Luminary Score points |
| Cry Havoc! | Craft the Dungeon Builder's Starter Set from the Lumen Station · Place the Barren Flameblade character from your Props tab in Build Mode (?/2) · Switch your Build Site to Play Mode, using [F5] or the Play button in the upper right · Open Lumen Station by clicking the Lumen count in the upper left menu · Close the Build UI [Tab], enable Play Mode on your site once again, and defeat the Barren Flameblades! (?/2) · Close build mode [Tab] and equip your weapon · Press [left mouse button] for Basic Attack · Press [right mouse button] for Power Attack · Place a campfire for out-of-combat healing. Extra campfires can be crafted in the Lumen Station · Return your site to Edit Mode, using [F5] or the Pause button in the upper right | 30 Lumens · 5 Luminary Score points |
| Getting Around | Use your axe to harvest wood from trees (?/25) · Use your pick to harvest ore, gems, or uncommon stone from the ground (?/50) · Open your Travel menu by using the blue crystal icon at the upper left · Visit a build site that is published in the gallery and use the calim banner to give them a 'Like' · Use the Travel menu to visit another player's build site · Ensure you are NOT in build mode or combat, then fire your grappling hook at your mouse cursor position | 30 Lumens · 5 Luminary Score points |
| Getting Crafty | Place the Replicator prop on your build site · Craft Cut Plain Wood · Craft a Farseer Pick · Craft Smelted Copper (?/3) · Craft Cut Agate (?/2) | 30 Lumens · 5 Luminary Score points |
| Modular Thinking | Undo [CTRL+Z] your last build action · Redo {CTRL+Y] your last build action · Select the "Modular Castle Window" Design and use the Fine Tuning advanced settings to Paste with Surrounding Empty Space into a wall · Select the "Modular Castle Window" Design and use the Fine Tuning advanced settings to Paste as Delete into a wall · Place the Modular Castle Long Room design from your Designs tab · Select the "Modular Castle Window" Design and use the Fine Tuning advanced settings to Paste with Interior Empty Space into a wall · Use Fine Tuning [T] to paste the Modular Castle Entry into the wall of the tower to make an entrance | 30 Lumens · 5 Luminary Score points |
| Props To You | Open the Simple Medium Chest prop by clicking on it · Open Build Mode [Tab] and switch to the Prop tab to see the props you can place · Place Simple Stool prop from the Furniture category in your Props. The movement option buttons at the lower right of the Build UI will help you position your prop! · Tint your Simple Stool using the Build Mode Tint tab · Place the Starting Location prop from the Special Effects prop category to set where visitors will arrive on your site · Creatures are a special category of props! Place the Target Dummy from your Props tab. You can use the search field to help find it by name. | 30 Lumens · 5 Luminary Score points |
| Your Home Is Your Castle | Press [TAB] to open Build Mode while on your Build Site · Place Castle Courtyard design · Place Castle Wall Entry design on your Build Site · Place Castle Tower - Inline design on your Build Site · Place Castle Wall - Medium design on your Build Site · Open Build Site Management window [U] · Customize your Build Site name · Open your Journal [J] and right-click on "Props To You" in the Getting Started category to track it | 30 Lumen · 5 Luminary Score points |
